privacy.heading: Cookies and privacy
privacy.lead: What WebScreen β stores in cookies, and what information it handles.

cookies.name: ws_oauth_state
cookies.purpose: Protects the Discord sign-in flow against forgery

cookies.name: _ga / _ga_*
cookies.purpose: Aggregates usage statistics via Google Analytics

paragraphs: When you sign in with Discord we store your Discord user ID, display name and avatar URL. We never receive your email address or password.

Converted videos get a public URL containing a hard-to-guess random ID. VRChat video players fetch it without authentication, so anyone who knows the URL can play it. Please do not upload anything you need to keep private.

We use Google Analytics to improve the site. The page URL, referrer, approximate region and browser type are sent to Google. The names and contents of the files you upload are never sent (analytics is not loaded on video preview pages).
To opt out, install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on that Google distributes, or block cookies in your browser settings.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Features that require signing in will not work if you do.

lp.intro: WebScreen is a video conversion service for showing web pages, photos and PDFs in the VRChat video player.
lp.webHeading: Convert a web page to video
lp.webBody: Convert a web page to video and play it on a video player inside VRChat. The seek bar of the player scrolls through the page.
lp.webMediaAlt: A web page being turned into a video
lp.imageBody: Photos from a world tour or from a night out with friends can be watched together in VRChat right away.
lp.imageMediaAlt: Photos being turned into a video
lp.pdfBody: Export PowerPoint or Google Slides as a PDF and convert it to video to run your presentation on a video player or a slide system.
lp.pdfMediaAlt: A PDF being turned into a video
lp.historyBody: Your history keeps the link to every video you converted. Videos are stored for 30 days, and the 10 videos you pin are kept indefinitely.
lp.comingSoon: Screen recording and screen sharing are still on the way
